notes.title: BeautiFun Games will be at IndieCade 2016
notes.content:
We’ll be attending the Californian festival from  Oct 13th to 16th! 

It’s been a year or so since our last videogame festival abroad, but Festival Season has arrived again for BeautiFun Games. This time, our studio has its next stop in  Los Angeles, California . We are already preparing our long journey to Orange County from the distance (Barcelona!), as you can see:

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5177596/73205af2160805afe3bdfc810b74842b9efc58ef.jpg

September has been a busy month for us: we have been preparing our trip and also giving the final touches to  new projects  we are currently working on… and we will be unveil some details sooner than later.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5177596/0cee7f65c8f2966a3b4e28e05a535bd5dfb7960c.jpg

Even though our game “Megamagic: Wizards of the Neon Age” was not selected in IndieCade 2016’s official selection, we will be attending the whole festival, including the IndieXchange and the GameTasting events. In case you are interested in getting in touch with us or to become acquainted of our games, just send us an email here info@beautifungames.com and let’s meet at IndieCade 2016… or at Hollywood Boulevard!

Have an incredible day,

- BeautiFun Games Team.

notes.title: Nihilumbra 1.31 update.
notes.content:
We just added some small but important fixes and corrections to the game's translation and language configuration: 

- Fixed a regression with the default language (thanks to Àlex Park for the heads up)
- Corrections in the chinese translation (thanks to 巨乳猛男)
- Corrections in the spanish translation (thanks to Jorge Pedraza)
- Corrections in the russian  translation (thanks to jago78)

Thanks everyone who, aside of playing it, is helping us to improve Nihilumbra!

BeautiFun Games.

notes.title: Nihilumbra 1.3 update is up and running!
notes.content:
Our beloved coders have been working hard to get rid of as many of the bugs you reported as possible.

After fixing and testing, here is Nihilumbra 1.3 changelist:

- Fixed a common default screen resolution problem.

- Fixed a strange bug with the default application language.

- Fixed a deadlock at the Ash Desert Void level, caused by application running at low FPS. 

- Various fixes with Chinese and Spanish languages.

Thank you all of you who reported your issues with the game.

We wish you have a great and much less buggy time playing Nihilumbra!
BeautiFun Games.
